 Testimonials 
 
 
 
 Hear What Our Incredible Customers Have to Say! 
 
 
 
 The people have spoken. Since being established, the masses have rated The Curry Modern Indian as the best Indian cuisine in Huntsville Alabama! Still skeptical? Check out our Google reviews. We love our patrons! 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

	

 

 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 experience excellence 
 
 
 
 What Makes Us Number One 
 
 
 
 Obviously our food is the most delectable. There’s no arguing that. But even beyond our delicious curries and dosas, The Curry Modern Indian takes extra measures to ensure the highest quality experience for our valued customers!Authenticity: While we take a modern approach to Indian food by utilizing top culinary techniques in our dishes, The Curry still maintains the authenticity and genuine flavor of traditional Indian cuisine. Huntsville citizens from India trust The Curry to transport them back to the greatest of Tamil, Punjab, Delhi, Gujarat and many other regions!Uber Friendly: We love our customers. Seeing people light up after trying their first bite of Indian food is one of our favorite things in the world! Our customers are the reason we ensure all our food is picture perfect before we send it to the table!Picturesque Ambiance: Speaking of picture perfect, we also have a passion for design and aesthetics. Needless to say, we’re pretty fond of our location. And apparently so are our visitors! Browse through Instagram and Facebook and you’ll see the boundless positive reception of our design skills. Is it as good as our food? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Visit Today
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 download our menu
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Samreen Ahmed 
 
 
 
 via Google reviews 
 
 
 
 I had their Indian Street Food buffet for brunch this morning and was shocked at how authentic it tasted. From the delicious pani puri to the perfectly boiled chai – everything tasted exactly as it should taste. As an American Indian- it’s hard to find authentic Indian cuisine especially in the South. It’s an even bigger plus that it’s 100% halal as I was told by management! The Curry exceeded my expectations. It tasted like home. I pray this establishment continues to grow so that everyone in Huntsville has a chance to taste exactly what Indian food should taste like! ❤️ 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Kristine Boyer 
 
 
 
 via Google reviews 
 
 
 
 They have just opened and are still trying to work out all the kinks of opening a new restaurant. Regardless the food and service were great and they really were interested in feedback on how they were doing which I think will make them a successful business. They offer a lunch buffet on weekends. I look forward to going back.Vegetarian options: This is a great place for people that want vegetarian or vegan options.Parking: This restaurant has tons of parking. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Fritz King 
 
 
 
 via Google reviews 
 
 
 
 We thought we’d give this place a go since it’s new.OH! MY!Are we ever so glad we did! This WILL be our Indian restaurant here on out! The food, friendly staff, the whole package… OUTSTANDING!!!We will be back. Hopefully, many times!
